name: norn
description: Norn: forecast the production impact of an engineering change. Skeleton + SpacetimeDB spike.

scripts.db:publish: npm run typecheck -w @norn/module --silent && spacetime publish norn --module-path module --server local --yes
scripts.db:reset: npm run typecheck -w @norn/module --silent && spacetime publish norn --module-path module --server local --delete-data=always --yes
scripts.db:generate: npm run typecheck -w @norn/module --silent && spacetime generate --lang typescript --module-path module --out-dir bindings/src --yes
scripts.build: npm run build -w @norn/module && npm run build -w @norn/web
scripts.test-db:publish: npm run typecheck -w @norn/module-test --silent && spacetime publish norn-test --no-config --module-path module-test --server local --delete-data=always --yes
scripts.test-db:generate: npm run typecheck -w @norn/module-test --silent && spacetime generate --no-config --lang typescript --module-path module-test --out-dir module-test/bindings/src --yes
